units.summary: Adds a public DB method that writes a caller-chosen set of head series to blocks and evicts them from the head. It sorts and de-duplicates refs, skips series with out-of-order data, and records new metrics and a block hint. It reuses the shared compactHeadViewLocked helper, which CompactStaleHead now also uses.
focus: Eviction only happens when the series has no sample with appendID above the watermark, and the OOO-skip filter runs before the block write, so no series is evicted without its data persisted
The new public API contract for external callers such as Mimir: unsorted or duplicate refs, unknown refs, and series with OOO data
Metrics and failure accounting on the early-return paths: an empty selection counts as triggered but not failed
Behavior of CompactStaleHead after the refactor to the shared helper, including the watermark parameter and the inclusive chunk-range loop
units.headline: Add CompactSelectedSeries to persist and evict chosen head series
units.reason: New public API that persists data and evicts series from the head under a lock, so data loss is possible if eviction is wrong.
